answer_1.quote: Against the ever-growing influx of textual content, being able to effectively summarize long pieces of text is crucial to extract useful information. Whereas once a significant amount of manual labour would be necessary, now automatic text summarization (ATS) can be performed by deep learning models...

answer_2.quote: Evaluating summaries is one of the most critical tasks in ascertaining the quality of generated summaries. Table displays how many times each metric was used to evaluate summaries in the reviewed papers. The ROUGE score is the most extensively used... while BERT/BARTScore and BLEU metrics are also used.

answer_4.quote: On a positive note, 7/17 of the papers perform some form of human evaluation... only two out of 17 studies employ human-based evaluation, involving two and three experts evaluating the explanations of summaries...
answer_4.guideline: Evaluating the explanations of summaries, including immutability and generalization to model reasoning patterns
